mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate relative to historical averages compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25% (t-test p>0.05 vs zero return).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.5%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that triggers corporate profit warnings and negative equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE > 8.5 (t-test p>0.05 vs zero return).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales growth indicate weakening consumer demand, causing a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint negative signal (HOUST decline and RSAFS decline) fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production relative to GDP growth (INDPRO/GDPC1 < 0.7) signals overcapacity and profit margin compression, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO/GDPC1 < 0.7 during late-cycle expansion (t-test p>0.05 vs zero return).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 0.25%, it signals an impending monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.25 (t-test p>0.05 vs zero return).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth and rising unemployment indicate a labor market contraction that triggers corporate cost-cutting and negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint negative signal (PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise) fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: During post-2008 recovery regimes, a stable federal funds rate below 0.5% supports risk-on sentiment and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during post-2008 recovery when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p>0.05 vs zero return).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production relative to historical norms compresses corporate output and profits, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines (t-test p>0.05 vs zero return).
